key_insight: GBClaw is an agentic AI framework designed to investigate atomic structures and deformation at grain boundaries—the interfaces between crystals in a material. It targets domain-intensive scientific investigation rather than workflow automation alone.
problem_solved: General grain boundaries make up most interfaces in polycrystalline materials but remain understudied.
